events.description: Walking along a curving, palm-lined driveway bordered by manicured lawns, flowerbeds, and American flags.
A black Mazda approaches on the driveway and passes the camera.
Looking toward a large light-colored resort-style building behind the hedges and trees.
Briefly consulting a navigation map on a smartphone while nearing the driveway exit.
Reaching the main road and continuing along the roadside sidewalk through an intersection with passing traffic.
Walking downhill on a tree-lined sidewalk beside a large, busy parking lot.
Checking the phone's navigation map again at the parking-lot entrance.
Crossing internal parking-lot roads and proceeding toward a path leading beneath the roadway.
Stopping at a posted tram-schedule map and moving close to examine its route information.
Leaving the tram map and following the descending access lane toward a concrete tunnel.
Walking through the illuminated corrugated tunnel beneath the road and toward the park-side exit.
Passing other tunnel users, including a person traveling with a small dog.
Consulting the smartphone map while approaching and leaving the tunnel exit.
Emerging into a landscaped park and following a winding path among palms, flowers, and grassy slopes.
Pausing beside a blue City of Dana Point park-rules sign and viewing it closely.
Continuing uphill through the landscaped park on a curving paved walkway.
Walking beside fenced recreation courts and along an adjoining sandy path bordered by blue flowers and wooden rails.
Briefly checking phone navigation while alongside the fenced courts.
Leaving the court area and entering an open grassy park with broad views toward distant hills.
Stopping at the Sea Terrace Park information board, examining its aerial map, and pointing to a location on it.
Resuming the walk past park visitors with bicycles and several dogs playing across the grass.
Continuing along a lamp-lined paved path beside a broad open lawn and landscaped slopes as evening approaches.
